summary: Established a fail-closed pre-development authority gate that distinguishes frozen ref prior art from the live official DeepSeek Harness contract, verifies the selected DSH checkout contains the current official master tip without changing its worktree, and records the compatibility evidence required before mutation.

pointers: DSH 官方上游权威门禁

steps: Verified that ref has no .gitmodules or Git links and contains only pinned RLM and Prime Agent source pointers whose ignored checkouts match their recorded commits.

Verified the parent DSH remote is the official deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness repository; fetched the exact official master tip 49a606bc5b5934603f22a26957a07dc799ab0291 and measured the ordinary local checkout at b150a551b8d465e31e418e1b2eaf5e79bbb7d28e as ahead=0 behind=1771.

Inspected the latest DSH tool, Subagent, Session, Agent, and system-prompt source boundaries used by the plugin, then installed published 0.1.2-alpha.5 dependencies in a detached task worktree and proved typecheck/build compatibility.

Drove the checker through RED for the absent command, GREEN for synchronized/behind/diverged/wrong-authority cases, then a successor credential-redaction RED/GREEN so diagnostics never echo remote URL userinfo.

Added the minimal project command, English-authoritative and Chinese readiness rules, AGENTS entry point, and ref clarification; updated the reusable agile skill generically so only policy-required or fast-moving upstream contracts trigger the gate.
Proved the real gate fails closed on the stale ordinary DSH checkout and passes on an isolated detached checkout at the official tip without changing either worktree.

evidence.note: 5/5 offline Git authority tests passed, including synchronized, behind, diverged, wrong-authority, and credential-redaction cases.
117 tests: 115 passed, 2 RLM_LIVE_SMOKE-gated tests skipped, 0 failed.
Project typecheck passed and production build emitted the expected 37.54 kB bundle.
A detached task worktree with agent/session/subagent/system-prompt/tools set to 0.1.2-alpha.5 passed typecheck and build.

evidence.target: pnpm check:upstream against ordinary and official-tip DSH checkouts
evidence.note: The gate correctly failed with ahead=0 behind=1771 on b150a551 and passed with ahead=0 behind=0 on 49a606bc.
The updated reusable skill and reference routing passed skill validation.

limitations: Latest DSH source/type compatibility is proven, but a clean Profile running the plugin on DSH 0.1.2-alpha.5 has not yet been executed; runtime compatibility remains a separate acceptance surface.

The ordinary parent DSH checkout remains intentionally untouched and 1771 commits behind; future work must point RLM_DSH_REPO_ROOT to the isolated latest checkout or another verified current checkout.
The reusable skill changes live at D:/skills/manage-agile-software-development outside this repository and therefore are validated local configuration, not part of the dsh-rlm Git candidate.
